name: pam_yubico
detailed_description: YubiKey hardware authentication module providing strong two-factor authentication using Yubikey devices. Supports both challenge-response and OTP authentication modes. Requires registration of Yubikey devices per user for authentication.
notes:
Hardware security key authentication
